chunks: And deny what We had given them, in order to go on enjoying themselves. They will come to know soon.

key_terms.بِمَا: with what / by means of what

ai.seo_question: Why do disbelievers reject divine favors according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological trap of *al-tamattu'* (worldly enjoyment) as a veil that leads to *al-kufr* (ingratitude or denial), illustrating how temporary pleasures obscure eternal truths. The phrase 'soon they will know' (*fasawfa ya'lamun*) is interpreted not merely as future knowledge but as the experiential realization of divine justice at the time of reckoning, a theme emphasized by scholars like Allamah Tabatabai in *Al-Mizan*. This reflects the broader Shia understanding that material blessings, if misused, become instruments of spiritual loss.
